title: DeepSeek Secures At Least $12B in Funding Before 2027 IPO
summary:
Tencent and CATL are leading a capital raise that may reach 100 billion yuan, or roughly $15 billion, as investor interest in the company's latest AI model drives demand. DeepSeek is nearing a minimum of $12 billion in the current round, surpassing its initial target of $7.5 billion, while originally seeking a valuation of 500 billion yuan, or about $75 billion.

The company targets an IPO in early 2027, with potential listings in mainland China, and will use the funds to deploy 160,000 Huawei accelerators at a data center in Inner Mongolia. This follows a previous external round that raised more than $7 billion earlier this year, positioning the firm alongside rival Moonshot AI, which also plans a 2027 public listing.

selectedTweets.text:
DEEPSEEK SET TO RAISE AT LEAST $12B IN TENCENT, CATL-LED ROUND AHEAD OF 2027 IPO

DeepSeek is nearing at least $12 billion in new funding, significantly above its initial target of roughly $7.5 billion, as investor demand surged following the release of its latest AI model, according to Bloomberg.

Tencent and battery giant CATL are among the largest investors in the round. Based on signed term sheets, the final raise could approach 100 billion yuan, or roughly $15 billion.

DeepSeek had originally targeted a valuation of about 500 billion yuan, roughly $75 billion, for the financing.

Once the round closes, the company is expected to begin restructuring in preparation for an IPO targeted for early 2027. Reuters previously reported DeepSeek was preparing for a potential mainland China listing. 

The new capital will help fund DeepSeek’s rapidly growing AI infrastructure needs. The company plans to deploy at least 160,000 of Huawei’s highest-end AI accelerators at a massive new data center in Inner Mongolia, while continuing to develop open AI models and pursue artificial general intelligence.

DeepSeek previously raised more than $7 billion in its first external funding round earlier this year, with Tencent and CATL also participating. 

The latest financing would position DeepSeek for one of the most closely watched Chinese technology IPOs in years, alongside rival Moonshot AI, which is also targeting a 2027 public listing.

Source: Bloomberg
